mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS artistId, a.name AS artistName, a.gender AS gender, a.avatar AS avatar, a.birth AS birth, a.area AS area, a.introduction AS introduction FROM tb_artist a WHERE a.id = #{artistId}

SELECT s.id AS songId, s.name AS songName, CONCAT_WS(' / ', primary_artist.name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(credit_artist.name ORDER BY sa.credit_order SEPARATOR ' / ') FROM tb_song_artist sa JOIN tb_artist credit_artist ON credit_artist.id = sa.artist_id WHERE sa.song_id = s.id AND sa.artist_id <> s.artist_id ) ) AS artistName, s.album AS album, s.duration AS duration, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.audio_url AS audioUrl, s.release_time AS releaseTime FROM tb_song s LEFT JOIN tb_artist primary_artist ON primary_artist.id = s.artist_id WHERE s.artist_id = #{artistId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_song_artist sa WHERE sa.song_id = s.id AND sa.artist_id = #{artistId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_artist selected_artist WHERE selected_artist.id = #{artistId} AND ( primary_artist.name LIKE CONCAT('%', selected_artist.name, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_song_artist sa JOIN tb_artist credit_artist ON credit_artist.id = sa.artist_id WHERE sa.song_id = s.id AND credit_artist.name LIKE CONCAT('%', selected_artist.name, '%') ) ) ) ORDER BY s.release_time DESC, s.id DESC
